name: praeko-js
description: Código-cliente do Praeko: @praeko/sdk, @praeko/cli e o Praeko Studio (@praeko/studio, studio-core, studio-kit). O servidor é fechado.

scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:studio
scripts.test:studio: npm test -w studio/packages/cli -w studio/packages/publicar -w studio/packages/voz -w studio/packages/revisar -w studio/packages/hyperframes
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/sdk -w packages/core -w packages/cli -w studio/packages/core -w studio/packages/kit
